name: Atom Massive Causal World

formal_primitive_contract.registry: typed signatures, output types, precision, root-mechanic composition, invariants, and executable transformations
formal_primitive_contract.truth_separation: runtime answers and independent oracle answers are computed through disjoint implementations before comparison
formal_primitive_contract.epistemic_projection: exact supported results are proven, false candidates are contradicted, and unsupported operations remain unknown
formal_primitive_contract.curriculum: deterministic indexed demonstrations, validation cases, held-out cases, and typed cross-domain programs
formal_primitive_contract.cross_domain_composition: a stage may consume a compatible prior result while preserving every primitive proof trace and invariant obligation

world_curriculum.construction: lazy mixed-radix composition of two distinct root mechanics and nine independent environmental axes
world_curriculum.runtime_effect: each selected regime changes initial state, relation topology and channels, and the seven root-mechanic gains
world_curriculum.evidence_binding: training evidence binds raw simulator traces and the full stable regime signature; evaluator truth binds rounded semantic causal measurements, program identity, and replica identity so equivalent results replay across numerical platforms

learning_contract.training_signal: matched treated and baseline intervention outcomes
learning_contract.effect_estimator: signed treated-minus-baseline response divided by signed intervention magnitude
learning_contract.conditional_laws: stable world conditions form distinct law variants; transient polarity, target policy, backend, and tick labels do not
learning_contract.causal_composition: compatible crystallized laws form transient provenance-preserving paths up to four links; composed claims are never stored as observations
learning_contract.unseen_regime_transfer: compose singleton condition factors with pairwise world motifs across all eleven conditions; require at least three persistent source regimes and a direction-specific acceptance band selected before final evaluation or return unknown
learning_contract.transfer_calibration: derive one policy-neutral context-factor trace using 80-digit decimal condition log-likelihoods and consensus, search direction-prior strength, pair-motif strength, and separate increasing/decreasing consensus thresholds on validation programs disjoint from training and final evaluation; compute Wilson risk statistics with cached 80-digit decimal square roots; project every portable statistic through a twelve-decimal half-even boundary before thresholding and hashing; hash the complete 5,000-policy projection lattice as policy-search state, bind the selected policy to the learned graph, and freeze it before evaluator inference
learning_contract.transfer_risk_contract: a policy is eligible only when its deterministic twelve-decimal 95 percent Wilson selective-error upper bound is at most 0.10 overall and 0.15 in each causal direction on validation data
learning_contract.transfer_evaluation: balanced increasing and decreasing cross-feature cases from programs excluded from both training and calibration, with truth regenerated by two independent treated-control replicas and sealed from inference
learning_contract.assertion_policy: derive only through a supported persistent evidence path; otherwise unknown
learning_contract.memory_policy: strengthen reproducible laws, preserve provenance, and decay contradicted laws

massive_profile.execution: one cached fixed-shape JAX/XLA executor across cumulative shards, using pmap across multi-device TPU assignments or jit on a single assigned GPU, with host-persistent graph consolidation
massive_profile.accelerator_contract: the requested Kaggle TPU or GPU must be present before execution; mismatched or CPU-only runtimes fail closed instead of silently falling back
massive_profile.resume_contract: atomic model and cursor state binds contiguous shards, per-shard evidence hashes, model lineage, and cumulative evidence count

language_contract: English is a procedural query and answer surface over graph concepts and complete world-regime conditions, not a second knowledge authority
knowledge_contract: runtime wiki graph plus graph-first RAG bind causal answers to learned laws and expose every typed formal primitive through executable domain relationships
artifact_view_contract: the right-side view renders the saved graph model, workflow, formal-domain measurements, cross-domain programs, gates, and evidence-bound laws
